meta.title: The Meg
meta.tagline: A deep-sea rescue mission turns into a battle against an ancient, giant apex predator.
description: Five years after a disastrous mission in the unexplored Mariana Trench ruined his career and marriage, former Naval Captain Jonas Taylor remains a disgraced sea diver. During that fateful expedition, Taylor aborted the operation and abandoned half his crew following a terrifying encounter. His claims that a giant, 70-foot prehistoric sea creature attacked his vessel were met with complete disbelief, costing him his honor and reputation.

An opportunity for redemption arises when a submersible lies crippled on the ocean floor, trapping a crew that includes Taylor's ex-wife. Called upon to lead a dangerous rescue operation, Jonas must confront his past trauma and risk everything to save those trapped below. To succeed, he must face the horrifying possibility that the legendary Carcharodon Megalodon—the ultimate marine predator—is real, alive, and actively hunting.
